items.question: How much water does hydroponic farming save in the UAE agriculture sector?
items.gold: Hydroponics saves up to 70 per cent of water.
items.fact: Hydroponics saves up to 70 percent water versus soil farming

items.question: How many commercial farms in the UAE currently use hydroponic technology?
items.gold: There are 87 commercial farms using hydroponic technology.
items.fact: 87 commercial hydroponic farms exist in the UAE
